title: Biscuits Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Formerly named Colors, this fully remodeled Seaside cottage is a stunning 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom beach house that sleeps up to 12 people.
description_expanded: Description485 FOREST STREET2 KINGS, 1 QUEEN, 2 TWINS, BUNK ROOM FOR 4A Classic Seaside Cottage, Beautifully ReimaginedTucked along Forest Street in the heart of Seaside, Florida, Biscuits is a fully renovated five-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom coastal retreat designed for relaxed gatherings and effortless beach living. Sleeping up to twelve guests, this stunning cottage blends timeless Seaside architecture with elevated modern comforts. Screened front and back porches, multiple rocking chairs, ceiling fans, and a charming hanging double swing invite you to slow down, kick off your shoes, and embrace a true barefoot holiday on 30A.Timeless Design with Elevated Coastal DetailsBeloved by returning guests, Biscuits retains its original character through exposed timber shiplap, while incorporating thoughtful updates like subway tile, luxury fixtures, and light-stained wood floors throughout. The result is a warm, beachy aesthetic that feels both authentic and refined—perfect for families and friends seeking a classic Seaside experience with upscale touches.Gourmet Kitchen & Grand Dining SpaceThe completely renovated main-level kitchen is designed to handle everything from casual breakfasts to holiday feasts. Highlights include a French-door refrigerator and freezer, gas cooktop, 24-inch microwave, and a generous 30-inch wall oven with ample capacity for large family meals. A spacious stone-topped island with bar seating creates a natural gathering spot, while the dining room’s soaring 22-foot ceilings and grand trestle table comfortably seat 8–10 adults for memorable shared meals.Inviting Living Areas for RelaxationJust beyond the kitchen, the expansive living room offers a welcoming space to unwind after a day at the beach. Enjoy a gas log fireplace, 55-inch curved Smart TV, slipcovered sofa, oversized upholstered chairs, poufs, and a cushioned window seat—ideal for movie nights, games, or quiet moments together. Screened porches extend the living space outdoors, where a large grill and dining area make al fresco meals a breeze.Thoughtfully Designed Bedrooms & BathsBiscuits offers a flexible bedroom layout ideal for multi-generational stays. On the main floor, the king primary suite features a private bathroom with both indoor and outdoor showers. A second main-level bedroom includes two twin beds and a private half bath, while an additional full bath with outdoor shower access sits just off the living room. A fully equipped laundry room with soaking sink and built-in ironing station adds everyday convenience.Upstairs, the home’s original spiral timber staircase leads to three additional bedrooms. One guest room features a queen bed, private bath, walk-in shower, and Juliette balcony overlooking Forest Street. Another offers a king four-poster bed, while the bunk room sleeps up to four and shares a spacious full bath with dual sinks, soaking tub, and walk-in shower.Premium Amenities & Prime Seaside LocationGuests of Biscuits enjoy premium linens and bathrobes, high-end timber blinds, curated artwork from the owners’ personal collection, and a calm coastal color palette throughout. The home is equipped with five televisions, Blu-ray/DVD players, Chromecast, and Wi-Fi. Two dedicated parking spaces sit directly in front of the cottage, and you’re within easy walking distance of Seaside’s swimming pools, tennis courts, fitness center, playground, and recreational courts.Staying at Biscuits places you in the center of the Seaside lifestyle—where beautiful design, walkability, and the Gulf Coast’s sugar-white beaches come together for an unforgettable Florida Panhandle vacation.Need additional space? Check out the guest cottage next door, Gravy, that sleeps an additional four.* 5 night minimum in Summer, Spring & Spring Break; 3 night minimum for Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES2,149 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space352 yards (approximately a 6-minute walk) to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach at East Ruskin Pavilion — the largest private residential beach on 30ACentral Forest Street location, just steps from the Seaside Chapel, shopping, dining, and town amenitiesFull-size standard oven, ideal for family meals and entertainingExtra-large charcoal grill, outdoor dining table and chairs, plus two screened porches for relaxed indoor–outdoor livingSeparate laundry room with soaking sink and built-in ironing stationPeacock Alley linens, featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (a golf cart is considered a vehicle). Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002042
